'''Dramatis Personae'''  is the 58th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on June 6, 2025. The set consists of 23 cards. This set first introduced the '''Xindi''' affiliation.

'''Dramatis Personae''', part of the thirtieth anniversary celebration, has a personnel for each affiliation, including the new '''Xindi''' affiliation.

==Type Breakdown==

*1 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*2 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*20 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (3 Bajoran, 1 Borg, 1 Cardassian, 2 Dominion, 3 Federation, 1 Ferengi, 2 Hirogen, 2 Kazon, 5 Klingon, 1 Non-Aligned, 2 Romulan, 3 Starfleet, 1 Vidiian, 1 Vulcan, and 2 Xindi)


'''NOTE:''' There are 10 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

*23 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
